fieldNotes.site: Jacksonville A-B brewery (opened 1969) at 111 Busch Dr; $30M 2026 investment announced. Brewery building with trailer drop yards W/SW, bounded by Busch Dr on the south, I-95 on the east, marshland to the north. 'Budweiser' sign on the building confirmed in Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Site fully fenced with chain-link confirmed in multiple Street Views (trailer yard, employee lot perimeters). Driveway truck entrances from Busch Dr at the SW corner. Controlled gated access - truckGate TRUE.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A-B breweries operate guarded truck entrances as standard. Booth structure not crisply isolated in imagery; classified guardShack TRUE per site type and fenced perimeter, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Two large organized trailer drop yards W and SW of the brewery, ~200+ trailers, capacity ~320.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks with trailers backed in on the W/S faces of the brewery; estimated ~30 (band 25-50).
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs run into the property from the west side trailer-yard area.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide yard aprons and entrance driveways leave room to add lanes.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Boxed footprint ~128 acres for brewery core + trailer yards.
